body:
Rule (approved 31 Oct): anyone can feed and pet farm animals; the feed bucket at the farm is free. No move for it yet.
Plan:
- Player tips the feed bucket into the trough; cows, sheep and pigs come and eat (head down, chew).
- Chickens: player scatters grain; they run up and peck.
- Horse: eats from your hand.
- Petting: player pats the head; the animal leans in, tail swish; a chicken fluffs up.
Models exist (feed bucket, trough, hay). Plan only today: the GIF comes after your OK.
